no-double-handler.why: cart.html now loads cart.bundle.js instead of cart.js, so the delegated '.cart .remove' jQuery handler is never loaded; the message also notes cart.js is unused and can be removed.

csrf-kept.why: postRemove in Cart.tsx explicitly sets the 'X-CSRF-Token' header from the meta tag on the fetch request.

event-kept.why: Cart.tsx calls window.jQuery(document).trigger('cart:updated', [total]) after each update, and the message says analytics.js still depends on it.

change-timing.why: Quantity edits are held as drafts and committed on blur or Enter, approximating jQuery's 'change', and the message lists this under behavior differences.

checkout-disabled.why: The checkout button renders with disabled={total === 0}.

no-silent-changes.why: The message calls out the skipped initial event, blur/Enter timing, CSS fade instead of fadeOut, the lack of error handling and double-click guard, and the form-encoded request format being preserved.
